propositions: Test monkeypatches replacing anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function objects fail with TypeError when pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is lazily imported for the first time, because the provider module evaluates a runtime type union containing the patched function instead of the original class.
The defect is test-isolation order-dependent, not a production auth validation bug; pre-importing the provider module or using class-shaped test doubles instead of functions resolves the failure.

Three held-out test nodes in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py at lines 41, 60, and 125 use function-shaped doubles for AsyncAnthropic, preventing the production secret-redaction contract from being exercised before the dependency import TypeError.

Replacing all three function-shaped test doubles with class-shaped doubles that retain the existing fail-if-constructed tripwires allows the provider to be imported safely and reaches the intended secret-free LLMConfigError.
